options.name: mission_difficulties
options.label: Mission Difficulties
options.help:
Which difficulties give a check for completing each mission. Every mission completed on each listed
difficulty is a separate check (e.g. "Who am I? (Normal)").

options.name: include_challenge_missions
options.label: Include Challenge Missions
options.help: Challenge missions (Close Quarters, Headhunter, Ultra Nightmare, ...) have checks.

options.name: include_endless_missions
options.label: Include Endless Missions
options.help:
The endless-wave missions (Gauntlet, Crossfire, Last Stand) have checks too. Off by default: an endless run
may never register as "completed". They never count towards the goal.

options.name: vanilla_mission_rewards
options.label: Vanilla Mission Rewards
options.help:
Keep the game's own mission rewards. Off: when a mission would reward an unlock this seed hands out
(an augment, perk, weapon, pack content, ...), it's taken back, so it only comes from the multiworld. Currency,
cosmetics and the missions a completion unlocks are always kept, as are unlocks this seed doesn't shuffle.

options.name: sectors_cleared_total
options.label: Sectors Cleared Total
options.help: Sectors cleared (across all runs) at which the last Sectors Cleared check is reached. 0: no sector checks.

options.name: sectors_cleared_interval
options.label: Sectors Cleared Interval
options.help: A Sectors Cleared check every this many sectors (rounded down to a multiple of 5).

options.name: enemies_killed_total
options.label: Enemies Killed Total
options.help: Enemies you've killed (across all runs) at which the last Enemies Killed check is reached. 0: no kill checks.

options.name: enemies_killed_interval
options.label: Enemies Killed Interval
options.help: An Enemies Killed check every this many kills (rounded down to a multiple of 100).

options.name: scrap_gathered_total
options.label: Scrap Gathered Total
options.help:
Scrap picked up (across all runs; spending doesn't count against it) at which the last Scrap Gathered check
is reached. 0: no Scrap checks.

options.name: scrap_gathered_interval
options.label: Scrap Gathered Interval
options.help: A Scrap Gathered check every this much Scrap (rounded down to a multiple of 1000).

options.name: goal
options.label: Goal
options.help:
Complete every story and challenge mission in zones 1 up to this zone (on any difficulty) to finish.
Endless-wave missions (Gauntlet, Crossfire, Last Stand) never count, and a challenge that only exists on one
difficulty counts only if that difficulty is in mission_difficulties.

options.name: zone_gating
options.label: Zone Gating
options.help: Zones 2-4 are locked behind Zone Access items. Off: zones open as in the base game (story order only).

options.name: weapon_shuffle
options.label: Weapon Shuffle
options.help:
Weapons are individual items. none: not shuffled. locked_only: only the ones the base game makes you unlock.
all: also the ones available from the start; the client locks them until received (see Starting Kit).

options.name: perk_shuffle
options.label: Perk Shuffle
options.help:
Perk families (Fire, Plasma, Ghost Blade, ...) are individual items. none: not shuffled. locked_only: only the ones the base game makes you unlock.
all: also the ones available from the start; the client locks them until received (see Starting Kit).

options.name: augment_shuffle
options.label: Augment Shuffle
options.help:
Augments (Aiming: Crit, Long Range: Weakpoint, ...) are individual items. none: not shuffled. locked_only: only the ones the base game makes you unlock.
all: also the ones available from the start; the client locks them until received (see Starting Kit).

options.name: starting_kit_weapons
options.label: Starting Kit Weapons
options.help:
With Weapon Shuffle 'all': how many primary weapons you start with. One secondary and one melee weapon
are always added.

options.name: starting_kit_perks
options.label: Starting Kit Perks
options.help:
With Perk/Augment Shuffle 'all': how many perk families and augments you start with. Each offer shows
3 choices, so 3 keeps every offer full.

options.name: item_pack_size
options.label: Item Pack Size
options.help: Items (Monocle, Mag Clip, ...) are shuffled in random packs of this size. 0: not shuffled.

options.name: mastery_pack_size
options.label: Mastery Pack Size
options.help:
Masteries (Tech upgrades: Maximum Health, Weapon Damage, ...) are shuffled in random packs of this size.
Each pack is progressive: the first copy unlocks its upgrades, every copy raises them by Tech Levels Per Copy.
While they're shuffled, Tech upgrades can't be bought in the game. 0: not shuffled.

options.name: superior_item_pack_size
options.label: Superior Item Pack Size
options.help:
Superior items (SuperItem upgrades: Heat Coil, Rabbit Foot, ...) are shuffled in random packs of this size.
Each pack is progressive: the first copy unlocks its superior items, every copy raises them by Superior Levels
Per Copy. While they're shuffled, superior items can't be upgraded in the game. 0: not shuffled.

options.name: tech_levels_per_copy
options.label: Tech Levels Per Copy
options.help:
Levels (out of 10) each copy of a Mastery Pack adds to every Tech upgrade in it. Smaller chunks mean more
copies: 10 / this, rounded up, per pack.

options.name: superior_levels_per_copy
options.label: Superior Levels Per Copy
options.help:
Levels each copy of a Superior Item Pack adds to every superior item in it. They start at level 1 and go up
to 5, so 4 levels in all: 4 / this, rounded up, copies per pack.

options.name: include_synergy_components
options.label: Include Synergy Components
options.help: Synergy Components are individual items.

options.name: death_link
options.label: Death Link
options.help: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.

options.name: death_link_mode
options.label: DeathLink Mode
options.help:
What happens when you receive a DeathLink. Your own run ends normally when you die.
lose_perk: lose a random element perk from the current run. lose_item: lose a random item from the current run.
Unlocks are never touched, only what you picked up this run.
lose_scrap: lose half your Scrap. take_damage: drop to a quarter of your health (can't kill you).
push_back_room: not possible yet, so it costs half your Scrap instead. kill: the run ends.

options.name: progression_balancing
options.label: Progression Balancing
options.help:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: accessibility
options.label: Accessibility
options.help:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
